"""Command line entry point: python -m shelvanta.cli <command>."""
import argparse
import sys

from . import storage
from .items import Item

DEFAULT_DB = "shelf.json"


def build_parser():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="shelvanta")
    p.add_argument("--db", default=DEFAULT_DB)
    sub = p.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    a = sub.add_parser("add", help="add stock for an item")
    a.add_argument("sku")
    a.add_argument("name")
    a.add_argument("--qty", type=int, default=1)
    a.add_argument("--location", default="unsorted")
    r = sub.add_parser("remove", help="remove stock")
    r.add_argument("sku")
    r.add_argument("--qty", type=int, default=1)
    sub.add_parser("list", help="list all items")
    return p


def main(argv=None, out=sys.stdout):
    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
    try:
        if args.command == "add":
            item = storage.add_item(args.db, Item(args.sku, args.name, args.qty, args.location))
            print(f"{item.sku}: {item.qty} in stock", file=out)
        elif args.command == "remove":
            item = storage.remove_qty(args.db, args.sku, args.qty)
            print(f"{item.sku}: {item.qty} in stock", file=out)
        else:
            for sku, item in sorted(storage.load(args.db).items()):
                print(f"{sku}\t{item.name}\t{item.qty}\t{item.location}", file=out)
    except (ValueError, KeyError) as exc:
        print(f"error: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
import io
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from shelvanta import cli, storage


class CliTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.dir = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.db = str(Path(self.dir.name) / "shelf.json")

    def tearDown(self):
        self.dir.cleanup()

    def run_cli(self, *argv):
        out = io.StringIO()
        code = cli.main(["--db", self.db, *argv], out=out)
        return code, out.getvalue()

    def test_add_then_list(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.run_cli("add", "A-1", "Widget", "--qty", "4")[0], 0)
        code, text = self.run_cli("list")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertIn("A-1\tWidget\t4", text)

    def test_add_twice_sums(self):
        self.run_cli("add", "A-1", "Widget", "--qty", "2")
        _, text = self.run_cli("add", "A-1", "Widget", "--qty", "3")
        self.assertIn("5 in stock", text)

    def test_remove_too_much_fails(self):
        self.run_cli("add", "A-1", "Widget", "--qty", "1")
        code, _ = self.run_cli("remove", "A-1", "--qty", "5")
        self.assertEqual(code, 1)

    def test_remove_unknown_fails(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.run_cli("remove", "ZZ")[0], 1)


class StorageTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_load_missing_file_is_empty(self):
        self.assertEqual(storage.load("/nonexistent/shelf.json"), {})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
